content.user_title: Plan and Improve Social Media Articles
content.value_statement: Social media articles often lack audience focus, clear structure, or measurable quality checks. This skill guides planning, drafting, review, and performance diagnosis.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests for new articles, draft reviews, headline work, formatting, and performance diagnosis.
Uses author positioning and audience personas to guide content decisions.
Checks topics, outlines, body text, headlines, and formatting against explicit criteria.
Scores draft readiness with publish, improve, or redo thresholds.
Identifies likely weaknesses in underperforming articles through the same review checklist.
limitations: The package references detailed method files that are not included in the scanned file structure.
Author positioning, prohibited topics, terminology, and audience profiles require manual customization.
The skill cannot verify search-result counts or performance metrics without supplied evidence.
It does not publish content, validate factual claims, or guarantee audience performance.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Article
use_cases.description: Turn a topic into an audience-aware outline with a clear promise and review criteria.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Draft
use_cases.description: Score a draft and prioritize revisions across topic, structure, body, headline, and formatting.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Weak Performance
use_cases.description: Compare an underperforming article with the checklist and identify probable content weaknesses.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft with the checklist. Give a score, explain failed criteria, and list the three highest-priority revisions: [draft]

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an article about [topic] for [audiences]. Define the reader situation, information gain, promise, outline, and review checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Headlines
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these headlines for clarity, numerical contrast, drama, and accessibility. Rank them and propose five stronger alternatives: [headlines]

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this article and its supplied metrics. Separate content weaknesses from unsupported assumptions, then recommend prioritized experiments: [article and metrics]

output_examples.input: Review a beginner guide that has no explanation of why the topic matters.
output: Main gap: The outline lacks a clear why section with three supporting reasons.
Priority revision: Add reader stakes, expected value, and credible evidence before the procedural steps.

output_examples.input: Diagnose an article with a strong click rate but weak completion rate.
output: The headline likely creates interest, but the body may not fulfill its promise.
Review paragraph length, terminology in the opening, visual support, and audience coverage.
Confirm the diagnosis with section-level retention data before rewriting the entire article.

best_practices: Customize author positioning and audience profiles before requesting article work.
Provide the complete draft, intended audience, channel, and available performance evidence.
Treat checklist scores as revision guidance and verify facts independently.
anti_patterns: Do not request performance diagnosis without sharing the article or relevant metrics.
Do not use placeholder audience profiles as final publishing guidance.
Do not accept dramatic numerical claims without checking their source and context.

faq.question: Can this skill write a complete article?
faq.answer: It can guide planning and drafting, but the referenced detailed method files are absent from the scanned package.

faq.question: Can it review an existing draft?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks topic choice, outline, body, headline, and formatting, then applies readiness thresholds.

faq.question: Does it support custom audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. Edit the audience profile file with at least three relevant groups before using the workflow.

faq.question: Can it analyze article performance?
faq.answer: It can identify probable content weaknesses when you provide the article and metrics. It cannot collect platform data automatically.

faq.question: Does it publish to social platforms?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides writing guidance and review output only.

faq.question: Does it verify facts and claims?
faq.answer: No. You must verify factual, legal, financial, and numerical claims before publication.
